info.name: Global Cash Management Recipient Contact Endpoints API
info.description:
The Global Cash Management API allows you to manage your recipient contacts, delivery channels, and delivery methods.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: help@vopay.com

urlencoded.description: (Required) Your account ID
(Required) API key for the account
(Required) Hashed signature for the request
(Required) The email address of the recipient contact
(Required) If the contact is an individual or business
(Required) Phone number of the recipient. Digits only, 9-15 characters. No spaces or hyphens (e.g. 19998887777).
(Required) Street address of the recipient. Must include a street name (e.g. 20 Longleat Drive). Numbers only are not accepted.
(Required) City of the recipient's address.
The client account ID the recipient belongs to
The ID for the recipient contact

Full legal business name of the recipient. Required if FirstName and LastName are not provided. Must be 2-60 characters and contain at least one letter. No abbreviations except standard suffixes (e.g. LLC, Ltd.).

First name of the individual recipient. Required if BusinessName is not provided. Must be 2-60 characters using only letters, spaces, commas, apostrophes, hyphens, and dots. No initials, acronyms, or company identifiers.

Last name of the individual recipient. Required if BusinessName is not provided. Must be 2-60 characters using only letters, spaces, commas, apostrophes, hyphens, and dots. No initials, acronyms, or company identifiers.
The second address line of the recipient contact
The province of the address
The postal code of the address
Country of the recipient's address. Accepts full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 code. Sanctioned countries are not accepted.
Date of birth of the recipient in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 1990-01-31).
The nationality specified using full country name or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.
The language preference
The source of income of the recipient contact
The occupation of the recipient contact
The sender's relationship to the recipient contact
